title: Heyhaat minnaz zilla
body:
heyhaat minnaz zilla
paigham e hussain ibne ali aam karenge
haq ke liyeh batil se sada ladte rahenge
har zulm ko awaz yehi dete rahenge
<<MINI>>
heyhaat heyhaat heyhaat minnaz zilla
<<DIVIDER>>
rokega kaise koi bhala matam e sarwar
hum gham bhi manate hai sabhi ashk bahakar
sar par hai kafan hum hai fidaye ali akbar
<<MINI>>
heyhaat heyhaat heyhaat minnaz zilla
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ashiq e haider hain suno hum hain hussaini
gardan ko kata dena hai miras humari
manzoor nehi humko yeh zillat ki zindegi
<<MINI>>
heyhaat heyhaat heyhaat minnaz zilla
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ne shahadat ka maza humko bataya
miti yeh shahadat hai shahad se bhi ziyada phir kyon na lade kyon na mare jaake karbala
<<MINI>>
heyhaat heyhaat heyhaat minnaz zilla
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke rouze main sada hoga arbayeen
jitna bhi chahe zulm karo kam e zalemeen
tum rukna chaho na rukengay yeh zayereen
<<MINI>>
heyhaat heyhaat heyhaat minnaz zilla
<<DIVIDER>>
karbo bala najaf toh kabhi jaaye samera phir kazemeen o shaam kabhi shehr e madina
nabood hum karenenge sabhi zulm aur jafa
<<MINI>>
heyhaat heyhaat heyhaat minnaz zilla
<<DIVIDER>>
naize pe sar hussain ka kehta hai aaj bhi
leila ke noor e ain ka kehna hai aaj bhi
nanha sa woh shaheed sunata aaj bhi
<<MINI>>
heyhaat heyhaat heyhaat minnaz zilla
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke parcham ko liyeh aage badenge
os bawafa ke naam ko roshan hi rakhenge
bazu bhi jo kat jaye agar kehte rahenge
<<MINI>>
heyhaat heyhaat heyhaat minnaz zilla
<<DIVIDER>>
humko hai intezaar zahoor e imam ka
mehdi ke saath saath rahein hai yehi dua
jab tak hai jaan dega raza bas yehi sada
labbaik labbaik labbaik ya mehdi
